outcome: Fix the four findings of the review of PR 18: evidence snapshots find the imported row at a position even when a column is named rowid, an evidence reference that is a file path resolves that file and its content before any artifact name, a timestamp bound on a date column keeps its time, and join diagnostics count each left group once when the join's key coercion lets it match several right groups
criteria: Importing rows [{"rowid": 1, "amount": 10}, {"rowid": 0, "amount": 20}] with evidence rows [0] and columns [amount] stores values [{"row": 0, "amount": 10}]; row positions are resolved by a mechanism no imported column name can shadow, for rows written inline and for a file with a rowid column

An evidence artifact written as a path (with a separator or ~) resolves that file: an existing file is found or registered by its path and current content hash, so /b/report.md never resolves to a registered /a/report.md; a path with a content_hash of a registered earlier version of that file resolves to that version; a path with the file's new hash registers the new version instead of returning CONFLICT; a hash that matches neither is refused; basename matching applies only to name references, and attach_metadata resolves its source the same way

Temporal contract bounds are compared in a type that keeps their precision: a date value and a timestamp bound are compared as timestamps with the date at midnight, so a date column checked against a noon lower bound on the same day fails, mixed date and timestamp bounds work, and README.md states the rule

Join diagnostics count left rows and keys from the left input once per left group and total each left group's right matches before judging multiplicity, so a float left key matching two integer right keys that coerce to it reports 1 left row, 1 left key, 1 key with several matches and 1 added row, with join_multiplied_rows advice; unmatched right rows are counted per right group
Each finding has a regression test under tests/, the backend test suite passes, and the fix is committed and pushed to the PR branch feat/issue-17

dispositions.note: 509 backend tests pass; the landing commit carries this outcome and is pushed to feat/issue-17 right after this close

note: DuckDBEngine.rows_at reads each position with LIMIT 1 OFFSET n over the table's scan order, and the engine states preserve_insertion_order on its connection. _find_artifact resolves an existing file written as a path by path and current hash first: earlier versions come from content_hash, a new version is registered, and a hash matching neither is refused. Only bare names fall back to basename matching, and attach_metadata shares the rule; workspace-relative names such as doc/notes.md still match exactly. BoundCheck.cast picks TIMESTAMP when the column or a bound is a timestamp, and check_values casts the column to the same type. compile_join_facts groups the matches of each left group (LEFT JOIN, sum of right group sizes) and counts unmatched right rows per right group with NOT EXISTS. Added 6 regression tests. MADR 0020 and 0021 received history entries.
